question: What set of negating attributes defines the supreme entity that is the answer to the preceding inquiry about the soul?
premises: The entity in question is supreme.
It is without parts and eternal.
It is free from disease and free from stain.
inference: That entity is the supreme, partless, eternal one, free from disease and stainless.
uncertainties: This verse states attributes but does not yet identify the entity by name in full relation to laya.
plain_english: He is the supreme, partless, eternal one, free from disease and stainless.
